about.meta.title: About OnFin — Who we are
about.meta.description: Meet the team behind OnFin: a broker built by traders, for traders. Transparent conditions, direct liquidity, and zero-compromise execution since 2015.
about.hero.title: A broker built by traders, for traders
about.hero.subtitle: Every day we work in the interests of thousands of traders making millions of transactions. Direct liquidity, transparent conditions, real people on the other end of the ticket.
about.story.title: 10 years of putting traders first
about.story.p1: OnFin was founded in 2015 by a small team of professional traders and market makers who were tired of what the retail brokerage industry had become — slow execution, hidden markups, and marketing promises that broke the second you deposited real money.
about.story.p2: Since day one the mission has been simple: give traders the same execution, liquidity and tools that institutional desks take for granted, and be brutally honest about the costs involved. No gamified dashboards, no fake bonuses, no requotes when the market moves.
about.story.p3: Ten years later, hundreds of thousands of clients trust us to route their orders. We still read every support ticket, we still run the same ECN engine, and we still believe the only sustainable broker is one that wants its clients to keep trading for decades.
about.values.title: Principles we won't compromise on
about.values.v1.title: Transparent pricing
about.values.v1.body: The spread you see is the spread you get. No hidden markups, no asymmetric slippage, no last-look rejections. Every tick is published and auditable.
about.values.v2.title: Direct liquidity
about.values.v2.body: We route directly to tier-1 banks and non-bank market makers. Your orders touch real liquidity, not an internal dealing desk that profits when you lose.
about.values.v3.title: Client money, always segregated
about.values.v3.body: Client funds are held in segregated accounts with top-tier banks. They are not used for operations, speculation, or anything else. Withdrawals are processed in the order received.
about.values.v4.title: Real people, real answers
about.values.v4.body: When you contact support you reach a human who trades the same platform you do. No scripts, no ticket black holes, no six-week escalation chains.
about.values.v5.title: Long-term thinking
about.values.v5.body: We don't chase short-term deposits. We chase decade-long relationships. Every product decision, from leverage to payout speed, is measured against that standard.
about.values.v6.title: Zero conflict of interest
about.values.v6.body: We make money when you trade, not when you lose. Our business model is built on volume and retention, not client churn — and we publish the numbers to prove it.
about.numbers.title: A decade of compounding trust

accounts.notes.n1: Leverage is tiered — it steps down from 1:3000 on smaller balances to 1:50 at $100,000+ equity. See the Leverage page for the full schedule.
accounts.notes.n2: Weekend leverage is capped at 1:500 automatically, from one hour before Friday close through Monday 01:00 EET.
accounts.notes.n3: Swap-free (Islamic) status is available on any account on request — contact support with your account ID to enable.
accounts.notes.n4: Spreads may widen overnight and during major economic releases. ECN commission is charged per round-turn lot.

• 1:2000 from $1,000 to $2,999

mt5.features.f4.title: Native strategy tester

mt5.features.f5.title: Built-in economic calendar

mt5.features.f6.title: Expert Advisors & automation

mt4.hero.title: The platform that built retail FX — still unbeaten for one thing

mt4.overview.title: Why MT4 is still the most-used FX platform
mt4.overview.subtitle: Yes, MT5 is newer. But MT4 is where the entire EA ecosystem lives, where most signal providers publish, and where most professional FX traders are still most comfortable.
mt4.features.f1.title: Instant execution
mt4.features.f1.body: On OnFin's ECN backend MT4 executes at the same speed as MT5. No requotes, no last-look, no dealing desk in the middle.
mt4.features.f2.title: The deepest EA ecosystem
mt4.features.f2.body: Twenty years of MQL4 code means more free indicators, EAs and signal services than any other platform on the market.
mt4.features.f3.title: One-click trading

mt4.features.f4.title: Multi-account manager ready

mt4.features.f5.title: Light on resources
mt4.features.f5.body: Runs happily on a five-year-old laptop or a cheap VPS. If you run a lot of EAs you'll feel the difference.
mt4.features.f6.title: 30+ indicators, 9 timeframes

mt4.download.title: Download MT4 for your device

deposit.meta.title: Deposit funds | OnFin
deposit.meta.description: Top up your OnFin trading account instantly with cards, bank transfer, e-wallets or crypto. Zero internal fees, full protection, funds credited within minutes.
deposit.hero.title: Deposit in minutes, start trading today
deposit.hero.subtitle: Pick the method that's cheapest or fastest for your region. We don't charge internal fees on any deposit channel — the amount you send is the amount you get.
deposit.intro.title: Three ways to fund your account
deposit.intro.subtitle: Cards and e-wallets are instant. Bank transfers arrive the same business day in most corridors. Crypto settles as soon as it confirms on-chain.
deposit.methods.disclaimer: * Number of transactions is not limited.
deposit.notes.title: Good to know before you deposit
deposit.notes.n1: OnFin does not charge any internal fees on deposits. Network fees for crypto and card-issuer fees from your bank are out of our control.
deposit.notes.n2: Deposits must come from an account held in your own name. Third-party deposits are returned automatically to meet KYC requirements.
deposit.notes.n3: Withdrawals follow the first-in-first-out rule: if you deposited by card, the first equivalent withdrawal must return to that card.
deposit.notes.n4: Your first deposit qualifies for a 100% trading bonus (credit, not cash) — opt-in from the cabinet at the time of funding.
withdraw.meta.title: Withdraw funds | OnFin
withdraw.meta.description: Withdraw your trading profits back to cards, bank accounts, e-wallets or crypto. Processed in the order received, with zero internal fees on any channel.
withdraw.hero.title: Quick and Easy Withdrawals
withdraw.hero.subtitle: Requests are processed quickly and without hassle.
withdraw.intro.title: How withdrawals work
withdraw.intro.subtitle: Because of anti-money-laundering rules, funds have to return to the same source they came from. That's not a policy we invented — it's a requirement every regulated broker has to honour.
withdraw.methods.disclaimer_2: ** No more than 5 transactions per day.
withdraw.methods.cards_note: Withdrawals are available only to cards of the MIR payment system.
withdraw.notes.title: Rules that protect both of us
withdraw.notes.n1: Funds must return to the exact source you deposited from (same card, same wallet, same bank). This is an anti-money-laundering rule, not a policy choice.
withdraw.notes.n2: If you deposited by multiple channels, withdrawals are distributed proportionally — first-in-first-out up to the matching deposit amount.
withdraw.notes.n3: Profit on top of your original deposit can go to any verified payment method in your name (most clients pick the fastest one).

ib.calc.title: An example worth walking through
ib.calc.intro: Let's say you bring 10 active clients to OnFin. Here's what that looks like in your partner wallet — and why most of our top earners started with just a handful of referrals.
ib.calc.p1: You refer 10 clients to OnFin through your unique partner link.
ib.calc.p2: Together they deposit $10,000 and start trading on MT4 or MT5.

ib.faq.title: Everything partners ask before signing up
ib.faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? The partner team replies in minutes — support@onfin.io.
ib.faq.q1.q: Are my funds and personal data safe with OnFin?
ib.faq.q1.a: Client funds are held in segregated accounts with tier-1 banks and are never used for operational expenses. Personal data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never share it with third parties outside of what's required by regulation.
ib.faq.q2.a: Most documents are reviewed within one business day. If everything you submit is clear and valid, your account is usually verified the same day you upload it.
ib.faq.q3.q: My documents were rejected by email — what should I do?
ib.faq.q3.a: The rejection email explains exactly what's missing or unclear. Re-upload the corrected document in your client cabinet — you don't need to start over, just replace the flagged file.
ib.faq.q4.q: My card verification photo needs a retouch — how do I do it?
ib.faq.q4.a: Take a new photo of the front of your card with the middle 8 digits and CVV covered. Make sure the card number (first 6 and last 4 digits), expiry date and your name are fully visible, and upload it to replace the previous file.
ib.faq.q5.q: Can I change my registration data later?
ib.faq.q5.a: Yes — contact support with your updated details and a copy of the document that confirms them (e.g. passport, utility bill). We'll update your profile within one business day.

copytrading.meta.title: Copy Trading with OnFin — Follow the pros, trade automatically

copytrading.how.title: Four steps to your first automated copy
copytrading.how.s1.title: Open a Copy account
copytrading.how.s1.body: Takes two minutes. Minimum $50. Same verification as a regular trading account — no extra paperwork.
copytrading.how.s2.title: Pick a strategy
copytrading.how.s2.body: Filter by profit, drawdown, trading style and risk. Every manager's history is independently audited and tamper-proof.
copytrading.how.s3.title: Subscribe
copytrading.how.s3.body: Choose how much of your balance to allocate (10% to 100%) and subscribe. The manager's trades start copying immediately.
copytrading.how.s4.title: Monitor & adjust
copytrading.how.s4.body: Track P/L per strategy from your dashboard. Unsubscribe, pause or change allocation any time — no lockups.
copytrading.forwho.title: Two sides of the same order book
copytrading.forwho.investors.title: For passive investors
copytrading.forwho.investors.body: You want exposure to active trading strategies but don't have the time — or the inclination — to watch charts all day. Pick a verified manager, allocate capital, and let their track record do the work.
copytrading.forwho.investors.b4: Manager gets paid only on profit
copytrading.forwho.managers.title: For strategy managers
copytrading.forwho.managers.body: You trade well and want to scale your PnL without taking client money into your personal account. Run your strategy on a single OnFin account — every subscriber's capital is mirrored, and you earn a performance fee on every profitable period.
copytrading.forwho.managers.b1: Keep full control of your trades
copytrading.forwho.managers.b4: Get promoted by OnFin to new investors
copytrading.safety.title: Why this is safer than lending someone your credentials
copytrading.safety.body: Your capital never leaves your own account. Copy trading mirrors the manager's actions into YOUR trading account — you still own the money, you still control the withdrawals, and you can pull the plug at any second. The manager has no access to your funds, only a performance fee on realized profit.
proptrading.meta.title: Prop Trading - Trade Firm Capital | OnFin Forex
proptrading.meta.description: Access real firm capital with performance-based funding. No evaluation fees, no lockups, no gamified rules. Earn on merit and scale as your track record proves itself.
proptrading.hero.title: Trade firm capital — earn your size, don't buy it
proptrading.hero.subtitle: Traditional prop firms charge you for an "evaluation" and hope you fail. We allocate real capital on the merit of a live track record, and we scale it up as you hit milestones. Zero access fees, ever.
proptrading.pillars.title: Four things every honest prop firm should have
proptrading.pillars.p1.title: Clarity, not guesswork
proptrading.pillars.p1.body: The rules, profit split and drawdown limits are published upfront. No hidden phase-two criteria, no "consistency rules" that only apply after you pass.
proptrading.pillars.p2.title: Risk discipline rewarded
proptrading.pillars.p2.body: Traders who size correctly and respect stops get scaled up faster. Over-leveraged hero trades don't pass our allocation model even if they happen to work.
proptrading.pillars.p3.title: Performance-first profit share
proptrading.pillars.p3.body: You keep 70% of profits by default, rising to 90% once you're scaled past $1M in allocated capital. No subscription fees, no "platform usage" deductions.
proptrading.pillars.p4.title: Zero access or participation fees
proptrading.pillars.p4.body: Our business runs on shared P/L, not on selling evaluations. The only money that changes hands is your share of the profit.
proptrading.steps.title: Five steps from application to funded
proptrading.steps.s1.title: Apply
proptrading.steps.s1.body: Submit a brief with your trading style, average R, and any public track record. Reviewed by a real trader within 2 business days.
proptrading.steps.s2.title: Prove on demo
proptrading.steps.s2.body: Trade our evaluation account with real rules (daily drawdown, max drawdown, risk limit). No time limit, no minimum days — pass it whenever you're ready.
proptrading.steps.s3.title: Get funded
proptrading.steps.s3.body: Hit the profit target once and we allocate real capital to a live OnFin account. Your rules and risk limits carry over exactly as they were on demo.
proptrading.steps.s4.title: Trade & scale
proptrading.steps.s4.body: Profitable quarter? Your allocation goes up automatically, and so does your profit split. Every milestone is published in advance.
proptrading.steps.s5.title: Withdraw

leverage.weekend.title: Weekend leverage
leverage.weekend.body: Forex leverage is reduced to 1:500 over the weekend as a risk-management measure. The weekend cap activates one hour before Friday's market close and lifts at the start of the Monday session at 01:00 EET.
leverage.explainer.title: Why Forex leverage tapers at higher equity
leverage.explainer.body: Very high leverage is useful when you're trading small size — it lets a $100 account actually move the needle on a trade. At five and six figure balances, the same leverage creates risk that almost nobody can manage in practice. Tiered leverage on Forex is the industry-standard way to keep execution safe for everyone on the same order book. Non-Forex asset classes (metals, indices, commodities, shares, crypto) use fixed leverage across all equity levels.
leverage.warning.title: A fair warning
leverage.warning.body: High leverage cuts both ways. A 1:1000 account can double in an afternoon — and it can also go to zero in thirty seconds if the market turns. Please only deploy leverage you'd be comfortable losing, and only on strategies you've proven on lower leverage first.

faq.meta.title: Frequently asked questions | OnFin
faq.meta.description: Answers to the most common OnFin questions — verification, deposits, withdrawals, leverage, swaps and platform support.
faq.hero.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.hero.subtitle: Can't find your answer below? Write to support@onfin.io or open the live chat — we reply in under an hour.
faq.verification.title: Verification
faq.verification.q1.a: Verification is the identity and address check every regulated broker has to run. It confirms you are who you say you are, and that the address on your account is current. We use a standard KYC flow — one photo ID plus one proof-of-address document.
faq.verification.q2.a: Usually under one business hour. Our verification desk operates 24/5, and clear submissions are approved within minutes. Complex cases (business accounts, third-party documents) can take up to one business day.
faq.verification.q3.a: Passport, national ID, or driver's license for identity. Bank statement, utility bill, tax bill or government correspondence dated within the last 90 days for address.
faq.verification.q4.q: How do I pass credit card verification?
faq.verification.q4.a: Take a photo of the front of the card showing the first 6 and last 4 digits, with the middle numbers covered. Cover the CVV on the back completely. Your name on the card must match your account.
faq.trading.title: Trading
faq.trading.q1.a: Leverage lets you open a position larger than your account balance — for example, 1:100 leverage means every $1 of margin controls $100 of notional exposure. It amplifies both profits and losses, so size with caution.
faq.trading.q2.a: Swap (also called rollover) is the overnight interest charged or credited on leveraged positions that are held past the daily cut-off (22:00 UTC). The rate depends on the interest rate differential between the two currencies in the pair.
faq.trading.q3.q: The "New Order" key is inactive. What should I do?
faq.trading.q3.a: This usually means the account is read-only (demo credentials logged in as live, or vice versa), or the market is closed for that symbol. Check the account type in the top-left of MT4/MT5 and the symbol's trading hours under "Specification".
faq.funding.title: Deposits & withdrawals
faq.funding.q1.q: Why do withdrawals have to return to the source?
faq.funding.q1.a: Anti-money-laundering regulations require funds to flow back the way they came. If you deposited by card, your first equivalent withdrawal has to go back to that card. Profits on top can go to any verified payment method in your name.
faq.funding.q2.q: Are there any fees on deposits or withdrawals?
faq.funding.q2.a: OnFin does not charge internal fees on any channel. Card issuers, SWIFT correspondent banks and crypto networks may charge their own — those are always disclosed before you confirm.
faq.funding.q3.a: E-wallet and crypto withdrawals are processed same day. Card withdrawals take 1-3 business days depending on your issuer. Bank wires take 1-3 business days depending on your region.
faq.account.title: Account management
faq.account.q1.q: Can I have multiple trading accounts?
faq.account.q1.a: Yes — you can hold up to five live accounts per verified profile, in any mix of Mini, ECN and Copy. Switching between them is free, and they all share the same verified identity.
faq.account.q2.q: How do I change my registered details?
faq.account.q2.a: For email, phone and address changes, use Profile → Edit in the cabinet. For legal-name changes, please email support@onfin.io with a scan of the document showing the new name (marriage certificate, name-change deed, updated passport).

genesis_policy.hero.title: Genesis Drop Rewards Policy
genesis_policy.hero.subtitle: How trading credits are accrued, when profits are withdrawable, and which actions can disqualify a participant.
genesis_policy.intro: This Rewards Accrual and Deduction Policy (the "Policy") governs the provision of rewards to clients in the form of trading credits within the OnFin Genesis Drop marketing program (the "Program"). Participation in the Program constitutes the client's full and unconditional agreement with the terms of this Policy.
genesis_policy.s1.title: 1. General provisions
genesis_policy.s1.p1: 1.1 This Policy governs the provision of rewards to clients in the form of trading credits within the OnFin Genesis Drop marketing program.
genesis_policy.s1.p2: 1.2 Participation in the Program constitutes the client's full and unconditional agreement with the terms of this Policy.
genesis_policy.s1.p3: 1.3 Rewards are provided in the form of trading credits and are used exclusively for conducting trading operations on the client's account.
genesis_policy.s2.title: 2. Conditions for reward accrual
genesis_policy.s2.p1: 2.1 Trading credits are accrued to the client upon the simultaneous fulfilment of the following conditions: completion of tasks stipulated by the Program's terms, and successful completion of the identity verification procedure (KYC) with the provision of a valid identity document.
genesis_policy.s2.p2: 2.2 Rewards are not accrued in the absence of, or failure to pass, identity verification.
genesis_policy.s2.p3: 2.3 The Company reserves the right to refuse reward accrual in the event of detected violations of the Program's terms.
genesis_policy.s3.title: 3. Profit withdrawal conditions
genesis_policy.s3.p1: 3.1 Trading credits are not subject to withdrawal or transfer to third parties.
genesis_policy.s3.p2: 3.2 The client may withdraw exclusively the profit earned from trading using trading credits, subject to the following conditions: a real deposit of no less than $50 to the trading account, and fulfilment of the minimum trading volume — 1 lot for every $10 of profit earned.
genesis_policy.s3.p3: 3.3 The required trading volume may be changed in accordance with the current terms of the Program.
genesis_policy.s3.p4: 3.4 In case of non-compliance with the specified requirements, the profit is not subject to withdrawal.
genesis_policy.s4.title: 4. Prohibited actions
genesis_policy.s4.intro: Within the framework of participation in the Program, the following are prohibited:
genesis_policy.s4.p1_body: Creation and use of multiple accounts by one person, or registration of referrals through controlled or affiliated accounts.
genesis_policy.s4.p2_body: Bots, scripts, click farms, or any other tools aimed at artificially simulating activity.
genesis_policy.s4.p3_body: Risk-free hedging, arbitrage without market risk, or any other actions aimed at abusing the Program's conditions.
genesis_policy.s4.p4_body: Document falsification, attempts to withdraw credit funds, or any actions contrary to the terms of this Policy.
genesis_policy.s5.title: 5. Sanctions
genesis_policy.s5.p1: 5.1 In the event of detected violations, the Company has the right to annul accrued trading credits, cancel earned profit, completely reset the client's trading account without the right of restoration, and refuse further participation in the Program.
genesis_policy.s5.p2: 5.2 The Company's decision is final and not subject to revision.
genesis_policy.s6.title: 6. Monitoring and liability
genesis_policy.s6.p1: 6.1 The Company uses automated monitoring systems, including IP address analysis, trading pattern analysis, AI monitoring systems, and other violation detection methods.
genesis_policy.s6.p2: 6.2 The client bears full responsibility for compliance with the terms of this Policy.
genesis_policy.s6.p3: 6.3 The Company reserves the right to change the terms of the Program and this Policy at any time without prior notice.

vip.notes.rebate.title: * Spread Rebate
vip.notes.rebate.body: The spread rebate is paid monthly, between the 1st and 5th day of the month following the reporting period. Only closed transactions on FX and Metals are taken into account, where the trade duration is at least 5 minutes and the difference between the opening and closing price is at least 30 pips.
vip.notes.interest.title: ** Interest Calculation
vip.notes.interest.body: Interest is accrued once per year on the account balance, calculated at the close of the last day of the 12th month following the program start date. The eligible balance consists exclusively of client deposits (net of withdrawals). Positive trading profits — realised or unrealised — are excluded; negative unrealised floating positions (drawdowns) reduce the eligible balance. Formula: Annual Interest Rate × Sum of Qualified Deposit Balances.
vip.notes.vps.title: *** VPS Compensation
vip.notes.vps.body: OnFin reimburses annual VPS server hosting costs based on the average yearly rental rate: up to USD 300 per year for Platinum and up to USD 500 per year for VIP. Compensation is credited to the trading account upon submission of a payment receipt for annual VPS rental to the Personal Manager. The amount is limited to actual rental expenses and does not exceed the maximum for the respective status.
vip.maintain.title: How to keep your status
vip.maintain.body: To maintain your status you must hold the minimum deposit balance and trade at least 20 lots per month. If these conditions are not met for three consecutive months, your status will be downgraded — the program rewards sustained activity, not just hitting a deposit target once.
vip.maintain.note: Additional requirement for the 5% annual interest: no withdrawals during the entire 12-month qualifying period.

blog.editorial.section.sources.body: Each article cites primary sources where possible — central bank releases (Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, RBA), regulators (ESMA, FCA, MAS, CFTC, SEC), the BIS, and the IMF. Statistics on retail-trader outcomes are drawn from regulator filings, not broker marketing material. We do not link to or cite competitor brokers as authorities.
blog.editorial.section.review.heading: Author and review process
blog.editorial.section.review.body: Every article carries a byline that links to the author's profile. Long-form trading guides are reviewed by a second editor before publication, with a focus on factual accuracy, the absence of guaranteed-profit claims, and the presence of a visible risk disclosure. Each article is dated with both a publish date and a last-reviewed date.
blog.editorial.section.corrections.body: When we get something wrong, we correct the article in place and add a note at the bottom describing what changed and when. Material corrections (factual errors, outdated regulation references) are corrected within one business day of being flagged. To report an error, email editorial@onfin.io.
blog.editorial.section.independence.head: Editorial independence
blog.editorial.section.independence.body: OnFin is a forex and CFD broker, and the blog is published on company infrastructure. The editorial desk operates independently of the marketing team: product mentions appear only when contextually relevant (e.g. a guide on MT5 may link to the OnFin MT5 page), are limited to one or two per article, and never replace primary-source citations. We do not accept paid placements or sponsored posts.
blog.risk.body: Trading forex and CFDs on margin carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for all investors. Most retail investor accounts lose money when trading CFDs. You should carefully consider whether you understand how these products work and whether you can afford to take the high risk of losing your money. Nothing in this article is investment advice or a recommendation to buy or sell any specific instrument.
